analysis: The only change in this PR is a two-line documentation edit in docs/developer/test.md (head lines 2057-2058). It extends the description of CI job-size tests to cover a `required` lane that keeps its fallback without asking while sizes are off. The two supplied units (lines 928-1360 and 1360-1806) are unchanged surrounding text. I read them against the threat model and found no changed security behavior. They describe test coverage for provider endpoint resumption and logout (T-053, TB-011), add-on hold (TB-012, T-059, T-060), the native serving qualification and SDK 27 Date-comparison checks, and the cluster and prompt fixtures. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache-storage (T-041), billing or availability logic is touched. The changed lines (2057-2058) are not in either supplied excerpt; they are known only from the patch. They describe CI routing test coverage and not runtime provider behavior. No new attack surface, invalidated assumption or threat-model gap is introduced. Remaining limit: the claim about the `required` lane concerns CI scripts and workflows that were not supplied, so I cannot verify it. It is documentation only and has no demonstrated security impact.
